text: Can you clean up this kitchen pic by clearing the loose clutter off the counter, rather than doing a renovation? I keep getting distracted by the mess when I look at it, so I’d love to see it tidied up. I just mean a cleanup of what’s sitting out, with the image staying a realistic photo in the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.
